svg.title: Adobe and Workspace Buy Gates
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-05-adobe-workspace-buy-gates; chapter number: 5; chart type: decision_tree; title: Adobe and Workspace Buy Gates; subtitle: Price the exit and verify the license before chasing a discount; caption: List price is a negotiable anchor, but cheap seats and retention offers carry hidden commitments that must clear four gates.; assumptions note: Sub-$2 Workspace seats often ride nonprofit, education or legacy panels that Google is suspending; a cheaper switch can cost $2,800 more in year one.; note: Attributed to Tech Meets East, InboxKit and Rook Technology Consulting.; nodes: gate: G1; question: Has Google confirmed the domain sits on an official partner license, not a nonprofit, edu or legacy panel?; pass next: G2; fail action: Reject the sub-$2 seats and file Google's support form for a phone callback.; gate: G2; question: Is the Adobe annual-paid-monthly exit priced, with half of every remaining payment owed on early cancellation?; pass next: G3; fail action: Do not sign until the exit fee is priced in.; gate: G3; question: Is it confirmed that retention free months do not restart a new one-year commitment?; pass next: G4; fail action: Decline the free months at the cancellation screen.; gate: G4; question: Does the switch case hold across current bill, replacement incl. retained items, one-time transition cost and the first date old commitments end?; pass next: Proceed with the purchase or switch; fail action: Hold the switch and keep the incumbent.

rect.title: gate: G1; question: Has Google confirmed the domain sits on an official partner license, not a nonprofit, edu or legacy panel?; pass next: G2; fail action: Reject the sub-$2 seats and file Google's support form for a phone callback.

gate: G2; question: Is the Adobe annual-paid-monthly exit priced, with half of every remaining payment owed on early cancellation?; pass next: G3; fail action: Do not sign until the exit fee is priced in.
gate: G3; question: Is it confirmed that retention free months do not restart a new one-year commitment?; pass next: G4; fail action: Decline the free months at the cancellation screen.

gate: G4; question: Does the switch case hold across current bill, replacement incl. retained items, one-time transition cost and the first date old commitments end?; pass next: Proceed with the purchase or switch; fail action: Hold the switch and keep the incumbent.

text.title: Assumptions: Sub-$2 Workspace seats often ride nonprofit, education or legacy panels that Google is suspending; a cheaper switch can cost $2,800 more in year one.
